verdict.rationale: Autumn documents some multi-item operations: multiAttach attaches several plans to a customer in one request, attachLicense assigns licenses to one or more entities, and `atmn push` syncs a whole config of features and plans in one command. All of these are scoped to a single customer or to the plan catalog, not true bulk actions across many customers or records. Missing for 10: a general bulk/batch API across many customers (e.g. batch track, bulk migrations or imports, which are per-customer), bulk actions exposed via MCP for AI agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
